question: Who is the knower of the field in all fields, and what is knowing?
premises: The Lord is the knower in all fields.
Knowing field and knower is deemed knowing.
The transmigrator's body is the field where karma-seeds sprout; the self stained by adventitious impurity is called knower, while the awakened know the same field distinctly.
inference: The one Self is knower in every field; true knowing discerns field from knower.
uncertainties: Long prose compounds segmented by sense; Abhinava's grammatical remarks (singular, genitive) rendered plainly.
plain_english: Know Me as the knower of the field in all fields, O Bhārata; the knowing of field and knower of the field — that is deemed knowing by Me. The body of transmigrators is the field, wherein karma-seeds sprout; hence their self, stained by adventitious impurity, is called the knower; for the awakened it is the same field distinctly.
